languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_memory_read
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads stored memory entries from CoClaw's memory store

query.description: Keyword to search for in memory

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_memory_write
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Saves a new fact or preference to CoClaw's long-term memory

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_memory_delete
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes memory entries from CoClaw's memory store. Can delete by ID, search query, or clear an entire layer. Pass layer='all' without id/query to wipe everything. Pass layer='longterm' or layer='daily' to clear that layer. Pass query to search-and-delete individual entries.

id.description: The exact ID of the memory entry to delete

query.description: Search query to find the memory to delete (used when id is not known)

layer.description: Memory layer to target. When used without id/query, clears all entries in that layer.

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_memory_update
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Updates an existing memory entry's content, type, or importance. Use CoClaw_memory_read first to find the entry, then update by id.

id.description: The exact ID of the memory entry to update

query.description: Search query to find the memory to update (used when id is not known)

content.description: New content for the memory entry

type.description: New type for the memory entry

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_workspace_context
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the active file, selection, and open tabs in VS Code

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_shared_memory_read
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read shared key/value entries written by sibling agents in the current multi-agent run. Filter by runId and optionally a specific key.

runId.description: The orchestration run id (provided in your system prompt)

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_shared_memory_write
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Write a key/value entry to the shared memory store for the current multi-agent run so dependent agents can read it.

value.description: The string value to store (JSON-encode complex data)

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_get_task_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect the live status of all tasks in a multi-agent run, or a specific task. Returns pending/running/done/failed and dependency info.

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_spawn_agent
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Spawn a new specialized agent task within the current run. ORCHESTRATOR USE ONLY — other agents do not have access. Resolves once the spawned task completes.

dependsOn.description: Optional task ids this dynamic task should wait for

difficulty.description: Optional difficulty tier controlling which configured model handles this task. Defaults to 'medium'.

languageModelTools.name: CoClaw_telegram_send_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Upload a file from the workspace to the linked Telegram user as a document. Use when the user asks you to send/share/email/upload a file over Telegram. Path must be inside the workspace folder. Max 50 MB.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path (preferred) or absolute path inside the workspace.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with CoClaw
walkthroughs.description: Learn how CoClaw adds persistent memory to GitHub Copilot.

steps.title: What is CoClaw?
steps.description:
CoClaw enhances GitHub Copilot with a persistent memory layer. It remembers your code conventions, preferences, and project decisions across sessions — and injects them into every LLM prompt automatically.

[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: Set Up Your Profile
steps.description:
Tell CoClaw about your coding preferences — language, style, indentation, frameworks. This helps it tailor responses to your workflow.

[Edit USER.json](command:CoClaw.editProfile)

steps.title: Customize the Assistant Persona
steps.description:
CoClaw's personality is defined in SOUL.json. Change its name, role, tone, or instructions to match your preferences.

[Edit SOUL.json](command:CoClaw.editSoul)

steps.title: Start a Conversation
steps.description:
Type **@CoClaw** in the GitHub Copilot Chat panel to start a memory-augmented conversation. Use slash commands:
- `/memory` — See what CoClaw remembers
- `/distill` — Save daily facts to long-term memory
- `/clear` — Clear today's session log
- `/soul` — Edit the assistant persona

[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: Browse & Manage Memories
steps.description:
Open the Memory Browser to see all stored entries, filter by type, promote daily logs to long-term memory, or delete entries.

[Open Memory Browser](command:CoClaw.showMemory)

steps.title: Run a Multi-Agent Plan
steps.description:
Type **@CoClaw /agents <task>** in the chat panel to break a request into a Planner → Coder(s) → Reviewer → Tester pipeline that runs through shared memory. Use the CoClaw activity-bar icon to watch the live agent tree, and tune `CoClaw.agents.mode` if you want every prompt to route through the orchestrator.

[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: Link Telegram for Remote Control
steps.description:
Run **CoClaw: Link Telegram Bot**, paste a token from @BotFather plus your numeric user ID (from @userinfobot), then send **@CoClaw /auto** in chat to start the bridge — or **@CoClaw /open** for OpenClaw mode (heartbeat checks, cron jobs, file delivery).

[Link Telegram Bot](command:CoClaw.linkTelegram)

CoClaw.model.family.markdownDescription: Preferred Copilot model family (workspace override). Pick a model from the dropdown, or [pick from the live Copilot list](command:CoClaw.selectModel) (always reflects the current Copilot inventory, including families newer than this dropdown).

OpenAI GPT-4o mini — recommended for light tasks.
CoClaw.models.light.markdownDescription: Model family for **light**-difficulty tasks (typos, renames, version bumps, mechanical formatting). Pick a model from the dropdown, or [pick from the live Copilot list](command:CoClaw.selectTierModels?%5B%22light%22%5D) (always reflects the current Copilot inventory, including families newer than this dropdown).

enumDescriptions: No override — fall back to CoClaw.model.family.
OpenAI GPT-4o — recommended for medium tasks.
CoClaw.models.medium.markdownDescription: Model family for **medium**-difficulty tasks (typical implementation, review, and tests — the default tier when the planner is unsure). Pick a model from the dropdown, or [pick from the live Copilot list](command:CoClaw.selectTierModels?%5B%22medium%22%5D) (always reflects the current Copilot inventory, including families newer than this dropdown).

enumDescriptions: No override — fall back to CoClaw.model.family.
OpenAI GPT-5 — recommended for hard tasks.
OpenAI o1 — reasoning model, good for hard tasks.
Anthropic Claude Opus 4 — recommended for hard tasks.
CoClaw.models.hard.markdownDescription: Model family for **hard**-difficulty tasks (multi-file refactors, architectural design, security review, complex reasoning). Pick a model from the dropdown, or [pick from the live Copilot list](command:CoClaw.selectTierModels?%5B%22hard%22%5D) (always reflects the current Copilot inventory, including families newer than this dropdown).

CoClaw.memory.maxLongTermEntries.description: Maximum number of long-term memory entries

CoClaw.memory.dailyLogsRetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain daily logs

CoClaw.memory.autoExtract.description: Automatically extract facts from responses into daily log

CoClaw.memory.tokenBudgetPercent.description: Max % of model context window to use for memory injection

CoClaw.memory.autoDistillThreshold.description: Auto-distill when daily log reaches this many entries (0 to disable)

CoClaw.memory.autoDistillIntervalHours.description: Auto-distill interval in hours (0 to disable scheduled distill)

CoClaw.memory.staleAfterDays.description: Long-term entries not referenced in this many days are downgraded in recall ranking (0 to disable)

CoClaw.heartbeat.enabled.description: Enable heartbeat (periodic autonomous agent checks) in /open mode

CoClaw.heartbeat.intervalMinutes.description: Heartbeat interval in minutes (how often the agent checks HEARTBEAT.md)

CoClaw.heartbeat.activeHoursStart.description: Start of active hours for heartbeat (HH:MM, 24h format)

CoClaw.heartbeat.activeHoursEnd.description: End of active hours for heartbeat (HH:MM, 24h format)

CoClaw.heartbeat.timezone.description: IANA time zone (e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata', 'America/New_York') used to evaluate heartbeat active hours. Leave empty to use the host's local time.

CoClaw.logging.level.description: Verbosity for the CoClaw output channel (View → Output → CoClaw). Use 'debug' to capture full traces when filing a bug.

CoClaw.telegram.sarcasticReactions.description: In /open mode, react to each user message with a sarcastic emoji.

CoClaw.telegram.tone.description: Conversational tone the assistant uses in Telegram /open mode.

CoClaw.telegram.silentUnauthorized.description: Silently ignore messages from non-linked Telegram users instead of replying with an 'Unauthorized' notice. Useful when the bot is added to shared chats and you don't want to advertise its presence.

CoClaw.telegram.useEmojis.description: Whether the assistant may use emojis in Telegram /open mode (and react to incoming messages).

CoClaw.agents.mode.description: Multi-agent orchestration mode. 'slash' = run only on /agents. 'always' = route every prompt through the orchestrator (experimental). 'off' = disabled.

CoClaw.agents.maxParallelCoders.description: Maximum number of parallel Coder agents the orchestrator may fan out for a single coder task.

CoClaw.agents.minParallelCoders.description: Minimum number of parallel Coder agents to spawn for a single coder task. When the splitter would produce fewer (e.g. for a small task), it is padded with generic lanes (implementation, tests, docs, ...) up to this floor. Default 1 = current behavior (no forced minimum). Capped to 'maxParallelCoders' if you accidentally set it higher. Use with care: a min above 1 forces parallel work even on atomic tasks like typo fixes.

CoClaw.agents.summaryMaxChars.description: Per-task character cap for the multi-agent run summary (and the copy persisted to shared memory). 0 = unlimited (use with care: a runaway agent can dump tens of thousands of chars into the chat). Ignored when 'CoClaw.agents.alwaysShowFullOutput' is true or when '--full' is in the prompt.

CoClaw.agents.alwaysShowFullOutput.description: When true, every /agents run prints each agent's full output without truncation — equivalent to passing '--full' on every prompt. Overrides 'CoClaw.agents.summaryMaxChars'. Use this if you regularly need long, untrimmed summaries; leave off (default) and pass '--full' ad-hoc when you want occasional long output.

enumDescriptions: Inject a final reviewer task at the end of the run, but ONLY if the plan doesn't already contain a reviewer that depends on every coder + tester task.
Always inject a final reviewer that depends on every coder + tester task, even if the plan already contains other reviewers.
Never inject. The plan's reviewers (if any) are used as-is.
CoClaw.agents.finalReviewer.markdownDescription: Controls the orchestrator's **final reviewer** — an automatically-injected `reviewer` task at the end of every `/agents` run that reads every coder/tester sibling's output and produces a single consolidated review with a verdict line (`APPROVED` / `CHANGES_REQUESTED`). The final reviewer is configured for the **hard** difficulty tier so it picks up the strongest model you have assigned to that tier.

CoClaw.tools.maxPerRequest.description: Maximum number of tools to send in a single language-model request. Most providers (OpenAI, Gemini) reject requests with more than 128 tools. The default of 120 leaves headroom; lower it if you still see 'Cannot have more than N tools per request' errors. Tools are kept in this priority order: user-prioritized → CoClaw_* → core file/edit/search tools → others (alphabetic).

CoClaw.tools.exclude.description: Case-insensitive substring patterns; any tool whose name contains a listed pattern is dropped before the request reaches the model. Useful for noisy MCP servers or extension tools you never want the assistant to call (e.g. ['mssql', 'jupyter']).

CoClaw.tools.priority.description: Case-insensitive substring patterns for tools that must survive the per-request cap. Bumps matching tools above CoClaw's own tools in the selection order — use sparingly (e.g. ['github_pr', 'k8s_apply'] to guarantee a niche MCP tool stays available even when 200+ tools are registered).
